scope: Unmodified BuildMirrorMap, Finalize, MirrorRotation, Matrix.Multiply/Inverse and AnimationList.Read/FindFile/GetMetadataByFile. RegisterPack executes original InitializeSkeleton, masks, sorting, Transform child calls and Finalize without hooking these bodies. Full retained arenas, global weights, allocator tags/order/size/alignment, library query counts, idempotence and failure writes compared. Original link matrices and reference poses retained; synthetic names, hierarchies, raw finite nonsingular matrices and metadata explicitly isolate boundaries. Missing/empty/unmirrored/additive-only/mirrored/mixed/duplicate/case-fold metadata covered. Nonfinite/singular arithmetic, actual scene Model/creature ownership and dynamic geometry remain outside this kernel acceptance.
